name: Splits prep
description: Dynamic swings, then hip flexor, hamstring and adductor holds that build toward front and side splits. Use blocks or a chair for support.

items.cue: Swing, do not kick. Let each swing go a little higher.
Swing across and out, keep the standing leg tall.
Bend one knee, straighten the other, keep the rhythm slow.
Tuck the pelvis and squeeze the back glute.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and lift your chest slowly.
Flex the front foot, hips square, hinge with a flat back.
Sink the hips low, keep the back knee down if needed.
Hands on blocks, hips square. Stop at a strong but calm stretch.
Rock slowly back and forth, knees wide.
Toes up, weight in your hands. Go only as low as you control.
